'''Izaiyah Etron Nelson''' (born October 1, 2003) is an American [[basketball]] player for the [[Orlando Magic]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA), on a [[two-way contract]] with the [[Osceola Magic]] of the [[NBA G League]]. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Arkansas State Red Wolves men's basketball|Arkansas State Red Wolves]] and [[South Florida Bulls men's basketball|South Florida Bulls]].

== High school career ==
Nelson attended [[Marietta High School (Georgia)|Marietta High School]]. He played football before becoming more serious about basketball as a sophomore in high school.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Ruiz |first1=Savannah |title=Inside the game of USF men’s basketball standout Izaiyah Nelson |url=https://www.usf.edu/news/2026/inside-the-game-of-usf-mens-basketball-standout-izaiyah-nelson.aspx |website=[[South Florida Bulls]] |access-date=April 5, 2026 |date=February 9, 2026}}</ref> Nelson averaged 8.6 points, 8.2 rebounds, 1.1 steals, and 1.0 blocks per game as a senior.<ref name="hines">{{cite web |last1=Hines |first1=Jamaill |title=A Scout’s Take: Izaiyah Nelson Demands Your Attention |url=https://www.noceilingsnba.com/p/a-scouts-take-izaiyah-nelson-demands |website=No Ceilings |access-date=April 5, 2026 |date=January 16, 2026}}</ref> He committed to play college basketball at [[Arkansas State Red Wolves men's basketball|Arkansas State]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Johnston |first1=Joey |title=Always On: Izaiyah Nelson’s Relentless Energy Is Fueling USF Men’s Basketball |url=https://gousfbulls.com/news/2026/1/13/mens-basketball-always-on-isaiyah-nelsons-relentless-energy-is-fueling-usf-mens-basketball.aspx |website=[[South Florida Bulls]] |access-date=April 5, 2026 |date=January 13, 2026}}</ref>

== College career ==
Nelson played three years at [[Arkansas State Red Wolves men's basketball|Arkansas State]] under coach [[Bryan Hodgson]].  He averaged 9.8 points and 7.6 rebounds per game as a sophomore.<ref>{{cite web |title=Izaiyah Nelson Earns Ro CBI All-Tournament Nod |url=https://astateredwolves.com/news/2024/3/27/mens-basketball-izaiyah-nelson-earns-ro-cbi-all-tournament-nod.aspx |website=[[Arkansas State Red Wolves]] |access-date=April 5, 2026 |date=March 27, 2024}}</ref> As a junior, he averaged 10.6 points, 8.9 rebounds, 0.7 steals, and 1.3 blocks per game and was named to the Third Team All-[[Sun Belt Conference|Sun Belt]]. Following the season, he followed coach Hodgson to [[South Florida Bulls men's basketball|South Florida]].<ref name="hines" /> As a senior, Nelson was named the [[American Athletic Conference Men's Basketball Player of the Year|American Conference Player of the Year]], defensive player of the year and newcomer of the year. He averaged 15.8 points and 9.8 rebounds per game.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Skol |first1=Mark |title=USF star Izaiyah Nelson more proud of team success than historic conference honors |url=https://www.fox13news.com/sports/usf-star-izaiyah-nelson-more-proud-team-success-than-historic-conference-honors |access-date=April 5, 2026 |work=Fox 13 News |date=March 13, 2026}}</ref>

== Professional career ==
On June 24, 2026, Nelson was selected with the 51st overall pick by the [[Washington Wizards]] in the [[2026 NBA draft]] and was subsequently traded to the [[Orlando Magic]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Former Arkansas State player Izaiyah Nelson drafted 51st overall by Washington Wizards in 2026 NBA Draft |url=https://www.kark.com/sports/former-arkansas-state-player-izaiyah-nelson-drafted-51st-overall-by-washington-wizards-in-2026-nba-draft/ |work=[[KARK]]|date=June 24, 2026 |access-date=June 24, 2026}}</ref> Nelson signed a [[two-way contract]] with the Magic on July 1.<ref>{{cite web |title=Orlando Magic Sign Rookie Izaiyah Nelson to a Two-Way Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/magic/news/orlando-magic-izaiyah-nelson-sign-rookie-two-way-contract-20260701|website=NBA.com|date=July 1, 2026}}</ref> On July 13, it was announced that Nelson would require surgery to repair a left ankle fracture suffered in a Summer League contest.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Magic's Izaiyah Nelson: To undergo surgery|url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/magics-izaiyah-nelson-to-undergo-surgery/|access-date=August 15, 2026|website=cbssports.com|language=en}}</ref>
